read.title: Update on Your Eye Patch Order
read.text:
Dear Mr. Haddad,

I'm sorry to let you know that your order of 10,000 hydrogel eye patches will be delayed by about ten days. Due to a shortage of a raw material, our factory had to stop the line for three days last week.

We are doing our best to expedite production, and the new shipping date is December 18. As an alternative, we can ship 4,000 units by air on December 8 at our cost, and send the rest by sea later.

Please let us know which option you prefer.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee

Dear Ms. Wong,

I'm sorry to inform you that your order will be delayed by one week due to a shortage of packaging materials. We are doing our best to expedite production. As an alternative, we can ship half the order this Friday. Please let us know which you prefer.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee
